{{Quote|Y-you're still '''wreckers!''' This is how '''my''' ship was brought down!''"<br />"''Yours... and '''all others''' that stray into the Drexel system.|Luke Skywalker and Governor Quarg|<ref name="MSW13" />}}
A '''sonic jammer''' was a tool used as a weapon by [[Quarg]]'s [[Quarg's father|father]], a well-known pirate who was defeated by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. With a group of jammers spread throughout the [[Korteen asteroid belt]], he wrecked passing ships and tore them apart for salvage. The Old Republic eventually ran him off, and he fled to [[Drexel (star)|Drexel]]. Once there, while using the jammer to draw starships to the surface so that the pirates could salvage their metals, he discovered that the devices affected the hearing of the [[Sea-dragon]]s, and he tried to defeat the [[Dragon Lords]] by using the jammers on their mounts. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] destroyed the devices, allowing the dragons and Dragon Lords to defeat Quarg.
